items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That’s where I met him. I actually played with him and Jukkis. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Great guy.

ctx.x: That’s where I met him. I actually played with him and Jukkis. I did a week in Helsinki in 2002. I was very saddened to hear.
Great guy. Yeah, it was devastating, tragic.
I guess they just found him on the street.
